# Akbar Alfaidah — Tech Agency
> Full-Stack Web, Mobile & AI Developer specializing in custom web portals, Android/Flutter apps, and Applied Machine Learning. Based in Jambi, Indonesia; available remotely worldwide.

## Core Services
- **Web Platforms & Portals:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker deployment.
- **Mobile Applications:** React Native, Flutter, Android & iOS production releases with geolocation, real-time sync, and offline resilience.
- **Applied AI & Computer Vision:** YOLO detection, BiLSTM / OpenCV pipelines, FastAPI inference services, and automated document extraction.
